intended_object: The property of an object X in a category with fibrations and a terminal object of being fibrant, meaning that the map X → * to the terminal object is a fibration. It is viewed as an object property, i.e. the class of fibrant objects (from the docstring and name).
explanation: The definition sends X to `IsFibrant X`, and `IsFibrant X` is defined as `Fibration (terminal.from X)`, which is exactly the standard definition of a fibrant object. The only assumptions are a class of fibrations and a terminal object, which is the natural generality. A model category structure is not needed. This is the `ObjectProperty` version of the `IsFibrant` typeclass; per the docstring, it exists so that the full subcategory `FibrantObject` can be built from it. It defines the class of fibrant objects correctly.
